title: Marginal loss and exclusion loss for partially supervised multi-organ segmentation
mechanism: Marginal loss sums predicted probabilities over the classes a partially labelled dataset merges into one label; exclusion loss pushes labelled pixels away from mutually exclusive classes.
evidence: Multi-organ CT from several partially labelled datasets; marginal + exclusion beat naive merging (numbers not re-read in this pass).
adaptation: UCF crack polygon supervised as log(p_crack + p_inactive); UCF background as marginal over all 24-class structural classes UCF does not label; UCF contact/corrosion/interconnect pixels excluded from crack. Single house softmax head, no new heads.
min_experiment: Arm B of joint run: single softmax + marginal/exclusion on UCF and MSS, 30k steps, 5 seeds. Baseline: house 5-seed. Metrics and kill line as MultiTalent arm. ~15 GPU-h.
prior_overlap: none; cross-dataset joint training never tried
